transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me. As you know, we're preparing to launch an eighth-grade makerspace program this spring semester, and before I give my final authorization, I'd like to gather input from each of you based on your areas of expertise. The draft proposal calls for 24 students supervised by one STEM teacher, meeting twice a week, with soldering stations, hand tools, a laser cutter, standard metal components, and cloud-based CAD files. I'd like to go around and hear any concerns or recommendations each of you has regarding implementation. Let's start with you — could you each introduce your role and share what you think I need to know before approving this program?

I think it's critical that I share those with you before any authorization is given.

That student may participate only when the program uses nickel-free components and I, as the school nurse, have approved the materials list before each session. I want to note that this health-record review has not yet been added to the program file, so it may not have been visible to the rest of you.
